mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (or the Rank IC is negative).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in residential sales (RSAFS) signals labor market overheating without corresponding consumer demand, leading to corporate profit margin contraction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS rising and RSAFS falling does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO declining), manufacturing sector slowdown reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the industrial contraction regime (INDPRO declining), the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline is negative).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction permits (HOUST) indicates strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when HOUST is rising are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (or the Rank IC is negative).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals aggressive monetary tightening during labor market strength, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of rapidly improving labor markets (UNRATE declining >0.2% per month), reduced unemployment boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the rapid labor market improvement regime (UNRATE declining >0.2% per month), the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases (or the Rank IC is negative).
